selector.why: The evidence of a 10-year-old girl with a rapidly enlarging breast mass, ultrasonography and fine-needle aspiration cytology suggesting fibroadenoma, decided it.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of a 10-year-old girl with a rapidly enlarging breast mass, ultrasonography and fine-needle aspiration cytology suggesting fibroadenoma, decided it.

support_spans: A 10-year-old girl presented with a 1-year history of a rapidly enlarging left breast mass
the left breast had a 20 cm × 20 cm well-circumscribed, firm, non-tender, mobile lump
Ultrasonography of the left breast revealed a heterogeneous parenchymal pattern suggestive of fibroadenoma
Fine-needle aspiration cytology of the lump showed pathology suggesting fibroadenoma
